titles.native: カードファイト!! ヴァンガード will+Dress Season2

description:
Yuuyu, Raika, and Touya were invited to America after their win in the "Deluxe" tournament in Japan.
They went on a tour of exhibition matches.
Danji, who had arrived earlier in America to look into the background of the Deluxe tournament at Michiru's behest, suspects a connection with the case of the missing fighters.
